meta.name: batch-orchestration
meta.description: Decompose large-scale changes into independent units and spawn parallel agents in isolated worktrees. Use for migrations, refactors, codemods, and any change touching 10+ files with the same pattern.

copy.tagline: 将大规模变更拆解为独立单元并行执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要跨多个文件做相同模式的修改
copy.tagline_en: Decompose large-scale changes into independent units and execute in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to apply the same pattern across many files

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的大范围修改指令拆成 5-30 个独立小任务，然后同时派出多个后台代理，每个代理在独立的代码工作区里执行一个任务、运行测试并创建拉取请求。
howto.when: 当你用 /batch 命令描述一个需要改动 10 个以上文件的机械性变更（如迁移、重构、代码转换）时触发。

say.text: /batch 把所有 React 类组件改成函数组件
/batch 给每个页面组件添加错误边界
/batch 把整个代码库中的 moment.js 换成 dayjs

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude decomposes your large-scale change instruction into 5-30 independent units, then spawns parallel background agents. Each agent works in an isolated worktree, implements the change, runs tests, and opens a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use the /batch command to describe a mechanical change affecting 10+ files (e.g., migration, refactor, codemod).

say_en.text: /batch Convert all React class components to function components
/batch Add error boundaries to every page component
/batch Migrate from moment.js to dayjs across the codebase
